arxiv-2202-13218.title: Mechanical, optical, and thermoelectric properties of semiconducting ZnIn 2 X 4 (X= S, Se, Te) monolayers
arxiv-2202-13218.creator: Mohammad Ali Mohebpour, Bohayra Mortazavi, Timon Rabczuk, Xiaoying Zhuang, Alexander V. Shapeev, Meysam Bagheri Tagani
arxiv-2202-13218.description: Abstract In the latest experimental success in the field of two-dimensional materials, ZnIn 2 S 4 nanosheets with a highly appealing efficiency for photocatalytic hydrogen evolution were synthesized (ACS Nano 15(2021), 15238). Motivated by this accomplishment, herein, we conduct first-principles-based calculations to explore the physical properties of the ZnIn 2 X 4 (X= S, Se, Te) monolayers.

arxiv-2501-02322.title: Sequent calculus for the subintuitionistic logic 𝖶𝖥 𝖭 𝟤 {\sf WF_{N_{2}}}
arxiv-2501-02322.creator: Fatemeh Shirmohammadzadeh Maleki
arxiv-2501-02322.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Fatemeh Shirmohammadzadeh Maleki. A cut-free G3-style sequent calculus 𝖦𝖶𝖥 𝖭 𝟤 {\sf GWF_{N_{2}}} for the subintuitionistic logic 𝖶𝖥 𝖭 𝟤 {\sf WF_{N_{2}}} , along with its single-succedent variant 𝖦𝖶𝖥 𝖭 𝟤 𝗌 {\sf GWF^{s}_{N_{2}}} , is introduced. The calculus 𝖦𝖶𝖥 𝖭 𝟤 {\sf GWF_{N_{2}}} is shown to extend naturally to a G3-style of the sequent calculus 𝖦𝖥 {\sf GF} for Corsi’s logic F .

arxiv-2503-15614.title: Graded Frobenius algebras from tensor algebras of bimodules
arxiv-2503-15614.creator: Sorin Dăscălescu 1 , Constantin Năstăsescu 2 and Laura Năstăsescu 2
arxiv-2503-15614.description: Abstract . We consider certain quotient algebras of tensor algebras of bimodules M M over a finite-dimensional algebra R R , and we investigate Frobenius type properties of such algebras. Our main interest is in the case where M = R ∗ M=R^{*} , the linear dual of R R .

arxiv-2508-09740.title: Unconditional uniqueness for the derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation by normal form approach
arxiv-2508-09740.creator: Nobu Kishimoto
arxiv-2508-09740.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nobu Kishimoto. We prove uniqueness of solutions to the Cauchy problem for the derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation in L t ∞ ​ H x 1 / 2 L^{\infty}_{t}H^{1/2}_{x} . Our proof is based on the method of normal form reduction (NFR), which has been employed to obtain the uniqueness in C t ​ H x s C_{t}H^{s}_{x} , s > 1 / 2 s>1/2 .

arxiv-2510-01189.title: An Anthropologist LLM to Elicit Users’ Moral Preferences Through Role-Play
arxiv-2510-01189.creator: Gianluca De Ninno, Paola Inverardi, Francesca Belotti
arxiv-2510-01189.description: Abstract This study investigates a novel approach to eliciting users’ moral decision-making by combining immersive role-playing games with LLM analysis capabilities. Building on the distinction introduced by Floridi between hard ethics inspiring and shaping laws—and soft ethics—moral preferences guiding individual behavior within the free space of decisions compliant to laws—we focus on capturing the latter through context-rich, narrative-driven interactions.

arxiv-2512-01569.title: Origin of Bright Quantum Emissions with High Debye-Waller factor in Silicon Nitride
arxiv-2512-01569.creator: Shibu Meher, Manoj Dey, Abhishek Kumar Singh
arxiv-2512-01569.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shibu Meher, Manoj Dey, Abhishek Kumar Singh. Silicon nitride has emerged as a promising photonic platform for integrated single-photon sources, yet the microscopic origin of the recently observed bright quantum emissions remains unclear. Using hybrid density functional theory, we show that the negatively charged N Si {}_{\text{Si}} V N {}_{\text{N}} center (NV - ) in the C 1h configuration exhibits a linearly polarized zero-phonon line (ZPL) at 2.46 eV, with a radiative lifetime of 9.01 ns and a high Debye-Waller (DW) factor of 33%.

arxiv-2602-16161.title: Emotion Collider: Dual Hyperbolic Mirror Manifolds for Sentiment Recovery via Anti Emotion Reflection
arxiv-2602-16161.creator: Rong Fu, Ziming Wang, Shuo Yin, Wenxin Zhang, Haiyun Wei, Kun Liu, Xianda Li, Zeli Su, Simon Fong
arxiv-2602-16161.description: Abstract Emotional expression underpins natural communication and effective human–computer interaction. We present Emotion Collider (EC-Net), a hyperbolic hypergraph framework for multimodal emotion and sentiment modeling. EC-Net represents modality hierarchies using Poincaré-ball embeddings and performs fusion through a hypergraph mechanism that passes messages bidirectionally between nodes and hyperedges.

pmc-10716410.title: Multiple sclerosis susceptibility may be associated with the coding rs20541 (R130Q) IL-13 gene polymorphism in the Polish population
pmc-10716410.creator: Cezary Grunwald, Edyta Adamska-Patruno, Natalia Wawrusiewicz-Kurylonek, Agata Czarnowska, Katarzyna Snarska, Agnieszka Dardzińska-Głębocka, Katarzyna Kapica-Topczewska, Anna Mirończuk, Marcin Bazylewicz, Jan Kochanowicz, Adam Krętowski, Alina Kułakowska, Monika Chorąży
pmc-10716410.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Some of the multiple autoimmune diseases have been already associated with IL-13 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs). However, there are only few studies regarding multiple sclerosis (MS) risk and IL-13 rs20541 (R130Q) polymorphism, and their results are conflicting. Therefore, the aim of our study was to investigate the frequency of the IL-13 gene rs20541 (R130Q) polymorphism in MS participants and its association with MS clinical subsets in the Polish population.

pmc-11439026.title: Nucleic acid binding affinity and antioxidant activity of N-m-Tolyl-4-Chlorophenoxyacetohydroxamicacid
pmc-11439026.creator: Rubi Khilari, Sohilkhan Chauhan, Mamta Tripathi, Rama Pande, Mohammed S Alqahtani, Rabbani Syed, Mudassar Shahid, Devashish Das, Avijit Sarkar
pmc-11439026.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hydroxamic acids represent a group of weak organic acids, both naturally occurring and synthetically derived, characterized by the general formula RC(= O)N(R’OH). In this study, we investigated the binding behavior of N-m-tolyl-4-chlorophenoxyaceto hydroxamic acid with calf thymus DNA (ct-DNA) and torula yeast RNA (t-RNA) through a combination of techniques including UV–visible spectroscopy, fluorescence emission analysis, viscometry, and computational simulations using AutoDock4 software. Our findings reveal that the mode of binding between the compound and the nucleic acids is consistent with intercalation.

pmc-12668304.title: A Triple Threat Against Ovarian Cancer: Os(II)‐Pt(IV)‐Ceritinib Conjugates for Photodynamic Therapy, Chemotherapy, and Immunogenic Cell Death Induction
pmc-12668304.creator: Marta Redrado, Sourav Acharya, Pierre Mesdom, Tomer Babu, James W Southwell, Laiane S Oliveira, Samia Hidalgo, Philippe Arnoux, Céline Frochot, Dan Gibson, Gilles Gasser
pmc-12668304.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Metal‐based anticancer agents offer unique opportunities to integrate multiple therapeutic modalities within a single molecular framework. Herein, we present the first Osmium(II)‐Platinum(IV)‐Ceritinib conjugate (Os‐Pt‐Cer) that synergistically combines photodynamic therapy (PDT), chemotherapy, and immunotherapy via immunogenic cell death (ICD) induction. This heterobimetallic complex features a photoactive osmium(II) polypyridyl core, a platinum(IV) prodrug derived from oxaliplatin, and the kinase inhibitor ceritinib as an axial ligand.

uslaw-usc-t43-s1345.title: 43 U.S.C. § 1345 — Coordination and consultation with affected State and local governments
uslaw-usc-t43-s1345.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s1345.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 29 (Submerged Lands); Subchapter III (Outer Continental Shelf Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Recommendations regarding size, time, or location of proposed lease sales Any Governor of any affected State or the executive of any affected local government in such State may submit recommendations to the Secretary regarding the size, timing, or location.
